description: Send a quote request to Rich at DrMaker3D for a person who wants something 3D printed or designed. Only with the person's permission, and only with their own name and email: Rich replies to that email, within one business day, with a price and a link to pay online (the person pays in a browser; nothing is charged here). Describe what it is, its size, material or color if known, how many, and when it is needed. A file is optional: give a public share link to an STL, OBJ, 3MF or STEP file, or a Printables, Thingiverse or MakerWorld model link; with no file, describe it (with measurements) and it is designed and printed, quoted together.

description.description: What they want made, its size, use, material or color, quantity and deadline.

email.description: The person's own email address, where Rich will reply.

file_key.description: Optional: the key POST /api/upload returned for the file (kind printiq or printiq-manual), e.g. the one quote_custom_print sent here for a hand quote.

file_url.description: Optional public link to the 3D file or model page.

zip.description: Optional U.S. ZIP or country, for shipping.

name: request_quote
title: Request a custom 3D printing or design quote
